create_dataset_instance: create a Dataset instance with a transform and mode to load RHD hand pose training or evaluation data
get_dataset_item: get a single training sample with augmented image, joint coordinates, and metadata from the dataset by index
evaluate_predictions: evaluate predicted 3D hand joint coordinates against ground truth and compute MPJPE and handedness accuracy
convert_handtype_to_array: convert a hand type string to a one-hot numpy array for left or right hand classification
load_rhd_annotations: load RHD dataset annotations from COCO JSON files and build a datalist with camera parameters and joint coordinates
